title: Onboarding Seed Pack
description: Optional pre-onboarding seed produced by the operator from a recorded pre-onboarding interview with the client. Dropped at the client workspace root as ONBOARDING_SEED.json before install day. If present, command-room-onboarding Phase 1a ingests it as anchor truth (same authority as the primary-affiliation gate): the connector scan validates and enriches declared entries but never overrides them, and may add undeclared entities alongside. After ingest, onboarding moves the file to _hq/data/onboarding-seed.json and appends an onboarding_seed_ingested event. Entities are referenced by name, not id — ids are minted during onboarding, and every name plus its listed aliases becomes an aliases.json mapping.

created_by.description: Operator who ran the interview and produced this pack.

transcript_source.description: Where the transcript lives on the operator side (e.g. 'granola: Acme pre-onboarding 2026-07-08'). Not resolvable from the client workspace — provenance only.

seniority.description: Drives the Phase 1a primary-affiliation gate: 'exec' means the primary org is the company they work FOR, not one they own.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Pre-answers the Phase 0 setup widget.

brain_name_preference.description: If the client picked an AI name during the interview. Pre-answers Phase 0; omit to let the widget ask.

orgs.description: Orgs the client named directly. Declared structure wins over domain-pattern inference.

parent_org_name.description: Name of the parent org in this same pack, if nested.

aliases.description: What the client actually calls it ('the AZ deal', 'ATC'). Each becomes an aliases.json mapping at ingest.

projects.description: Workstreams the client named directly. kind/status vocabulary matches entities.schema.json threads.

org_name.description: Affiliated org by name (most specific level).

priority.description: 'top' = one of the client's declared top-3 focuses. Drives briefing ordering from day one.

people.description: People the client named directly — team, key externals, board.

relationship.description: Freeform relationship to the client ('co-founder', 'EA', 'lead investor', 'biggest customer').

deep_track.description: Client flagged this person as someone to track closely, regardless of email volume.

language.description: Workspace language, anchor truth — 'es' activates the bilingual overlay (onboarding writes _hq/data/skill_config/language.json via the atomic writer and fills the {{LANGUAGE_PREF}} CLAUDE.md slot) and the language question is never asked; 'en' (or absent) leaves the install byte-identical to English-native. Bilingual, never Spanish-only.

priorities.description: The client's declared current focuses, in their words, ordered. Connector scans see volume; this sees importance.

linked_entity_name.description: Org/project/person name in this pack it maps to, if any.

voice.description: Feeds BRAND_VOICE.md / COMMUNICATION_PROFILE.md alongside the sent-mail scan. The interview transcript itself is spoken voice — treat as secondary to written-voice evidence (the spoken-secondary principle lives in command-room-onboarding/SKILL.md's Phase-1 voice-scan step, NOT in VOICE_CALIBRATION.md).

self_described.description: How the client says they write ('short, no pleasantries', 'always warm openers').

sample_phrases.description: Verbatim phrases the client reaches for, pulled from the transcript.

sensitivities.description: Topics, threads, or people to exclude or handle carefully (legal matters, a departing employee, personal threads). Onboarding respects these during the scan and never surfaces them in demo beats.

directives.description: Workspace-directive answers captured in the interview (per-client skill customization layer). Applied as workspace directives at ingest.

open_questions.description: What the interview didn't answer. Onboarding surfaces these to the operator on install day; they are NOT asked to the client mid-demo.
